description: Return the status of a gallery template proposal by the tracking code propose_template gave: comparing (it waits a little while the comparison renders), review (with the comparison sheet as an image: original and recreation side by side at the same moments), rendering (its media are rendered and it is being committed to the Studio code), published (with its template id and the link of its pull request, whose preview shows it in the gallery), failed (with the reason) or retired.
name: get_proposal_status
title: Get template status
